purpose: Describe something happening abruptly without preparation.
keywords: The phone suddenly rang in the quiet room.
I was surprised when someone I had just met abruptly asked my address.
Do not start running without warming up.
restrictions: Emphasizes the lack of warning or intervening steps.
mistake: Do not use it merely for a fast action with clear preparation.
